# phase-475 W3 — the nros-tests targets the gate lane RUNS, GENERATED by the
# lane census in the gate image: every target that reached a PASS in EVERY
# census run, with nothing staged. Never edit it — regenerate it:
#     scripts/test/lane-census.sh <gate-image> --runs 2 \
#         --admit .config/lane-admission/gate.txt
#
# One name per line. `lib` is the crate's own unit tests (`--lib`); every
# other bare name is a `--test` target, admitted WHOLE. `<target>::<test>` is
# ONE test of a target that is not admissible whole, because a sibling skips,
# needs a fixture or fails here. `test-lane-contracts` runs exactly this set,
# and `check-lane-contracts` reads it — per test for a `::` row — so an
# admitted test that resolves a fixture its job does not build is refused.
